_comment_rewrites: Vercel checks the filesystem BEFORE rewrites, so a rule for '/' can never
fire while an index.html exists. The dispatch therefore lives at
dispatch.html (served at /dispatch by cleanUrls) and nothing sits at the
root, which lets these rules decide what each domain shows.
Order matters: the host-specific rule must come first.
